channel.title: Vienna Public Transport — Disruptions & Commuter Info
channel.description: Active disruptions, construction works and restrictions from official sources (Wiener Linien, ÖBB, VOR/VAO, City of Vienna).

item.title: Ebenfurth
item.description: Due to a fire brigade operation, no journeys are possible in Ebenfurth train station until expected 10:00 clock. [Since 16.08.2026]
item.content:encoded:
Due to a fire brigade operation, no journeys are possible in Ebenfurth train station until expected 10:00 clock.
[Since 16.08.2026]

item.title: Wien Hetzendorf ↔ Wien Liesing
item.description: Due to an switch fault train journeys between Wien Hetzendorf Bahnhst and Wien Liesing train station to expected 09:40 clock are limited. [Since 16.08.2026]
item.content:encoded:
Due to an switch fault train journeys between Wien Hetzendorf Bahnhst and Wien Liesing train station to expected 09:40 clock are limited.

item.title: U4: U4 folding ramp lock on 16.08.2026
item.description: Due to the high passenger volume associated with an event, the folding ramps of the U4 underground trains cannot be extended. [15.08.2026 – 16.08.2026]
item.content:encoded:
Due to the high passenger volume associated with an event, the folding ramps of the U4 underground trains cannot be extended.
